seoTitle: GitHub Secret Scanner - Find Leaked API Keys | Gitleaks
seoDescription: Scan GitHub for leaked API keys across 30+ services (Razorpay, Stripe, AWS, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Supabase, Firebase, GitHub PATs + more). Cloud-hosted gitleaks. Smart key-secret pairing.
exampleRunInput$comment: The prefill: trufflesecurity/test_keys exists so secret scanners have something to find (4 s, 2 findings, run Wfs0yidvduAigm7ED). The old prefill searched all of GitHub and cloned 15 repos, 10 s to 246 s of the daily test's 300 s; the old example input used fields the schema no longer has (target_mode, target_value, max_repos).

pricing.$comment: Store discounts (owner's Gentle ladder, rolled out 2026-10-29 after holehe and social-analyzer): Free and Starter keep the flat price, Scale pays 10% less, Business and above 20% less; apify-actor-start stays flat. Aug-Oct paid revenue of this actor came almost all from Starter, and Apify bills our platform cost of Scale and Business runs lower only when discounts are on (compute $0.16 and $0.13 per CU instead of $0.20, https://docs.apify.com/actors/monetize/pricing-and-costs.md). The CI script applies first-time pricing and decreases; increases go through Console with 14 days' notice.

actor_start.eventDescription: Charged once per run for the lister + scan orchestration.

per_repo_scanned.eventDescription: Charged once per repo successfully cloned and scanned. Unreachable repos are not charged.
